SELECT v.*, CASE WHEN v.status = '5' THEN '5' WHEN v.status = '4' THEN '4' WHEN cu.usage_id IS NOT NULL THEN '3' WHEN nu.usage_id IS NOT NULL THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS runtime_status, cu.usage_id AS current_usage_id, cu.status AS current_usage_status, COALESCE(u1.nick_name, u1.user_name) AS current_user_name, COALESCE(u2.nick_name, u2.user_name) AS current_driver_name, cu.destination AS current_destination, COALESCE(cu.actual_end_time, cu.end_time) AS planned_return_time, nu.start_time AS next_booking_start_time, TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM CONCAT( CASE WHEN v.insurance_expiry IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(v.insurance_expiry, CURDATE()) IN (30,15,7,1,0) THEN '保险到期,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN v.annual_inspection_expiry IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(v.annual_inspection_expiry, CURDATE()) IN (30,15,7,1,0) THEN '年检到期,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN v.next_maintenance_mileage IS NOT NULL AND v.mileage IS NOT NULL AND (v.next_maintenance_mileage - v.mileage) <= 500 THEN '保养到期,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN vr.open_risk_count > 0 THEN '风险待处理,' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN vv.pending_violation_count > 0 THEN '违章待处理,' ELSE '' END )) AS warning_tags, COALESCE(ve30.expense_amount_30d, 0) AS expense_amount_30d FROM sys_vehicle v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.* FROM sys_vehicle_usage t INNER JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(COALESCE(dispatch_time, actual_start_time, start_time)) AS max_time FROM sys_vehicle_usage WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '3' GROUP BY vehicle_id ) latest ON latest.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id AND latest.max_time = COALESCE(t.dispatch_time, t.actual_start_time, t.start_time) WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.status = '3' ) cu ON cu.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.* FROM sys_vehicle_usage t INNER JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, MIN(start_time) AS min_start_time FROM sys_vehicle_usage WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('0','1') AND start_time >= NOW() GROUP BY vehicle_id ) next_one ON next_one.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id AND next_one.min_start_time = t.start_time WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.status IN ('0','1') AND t.start_time >= NOW() ) nu ON nu.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON u1.user_id = cu.applicant_id AND u1.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON u2.user_id = cu.driver_id AND u2.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(amount) AS expense_amount_30d FROM sys_vehicle_expense WHERE expense_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY vehicle_id ) ve30 ON ve30.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT business_id AS vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS open_risk_count FROM oa_risk_alert WHERE business_type = 'VEHICLE' AND risk_status IN ('OPEN', 'HANDLING') GROUP BY business_id ) vr ON vr.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_violation_count FROM sys_vehicle_violation WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') GROUP BY vehicle_id ) vv ON vv.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
AND v.license_plate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.licensePlate}, '%')
AND v.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.brand}, '%')
AND ( CASE WHEN v.status = '5' THEN '5' WHEN v.status = '4' THEN '4' WHEN cu.usage_id IS NOT NULL THEN '3' WHEN nu.usage_id IS NOT NULL THEN '2' ELSE '1' END ) = #{query.status}
AND v.del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.vehicle_id DESC

SELECT v.*, '1' AS runtime_status, COALESCE(ve30.expense_amount_30d, 0) AS expense_amount_30d FROM sys_vehicle v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(amount) AS expense_amount_30d FROM sys_vehicle_expense WHERE expense_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY vehicle_id ) ve30 ON ve30.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE v.del_flag = '0' AND v.status = '1' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_vehicle_usage u WHERE u.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '3' ) ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.vehicle_id DESC
